result.rationale: The diff adds `group.users.delete(user_id)` where `user_id = params.require(:user_id).to_i` (admin/groups_controller.rb, remove_member). A has_many collection's delete expects model instances; passing an Integer raises ActiveRecord::AssociationTypeMismatch rather than removing the join record. The suggested fix (delete a User instance or use group.remove) is standard. Verified from the diff lines showing the Integer coercion immediately before the delete call.

adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member` does `group.users.delete(user_id)` where `user_id` is an Integer. Rails `has_many`/`has_many :through` collection `delete` supports passing ids (not only model instances), so this does not necessarily raise `ActiveRecord::AssociationTypeMismatch`. The added spec `xhr :delete, :remove_member, group_id: group.id, user_id: user.id` expects the member count to drop to 0, indicating the intended behavior is supported in this codebase.
